left.title: Studium fixture: hydrostatic difference
left.text: Fixture excerpt, not a university document. The relation is dp = rho * g * h. rho is 1000, the gravity fraction uses 981 and 100, and h is 2. The worked difference uses 1000 * 981 * 2 / 100.
